citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv.
creator: Mohamed A. Rashad (Ain Shams University)
description: A large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books using the Arabic-Nougat OCR model, released as a resource for downstream Arabic NLP and OCR research.
name: arabic-books
rai:dataBiases: Because the dataset consists of tokens extracted from Arabic literature using the authors' OCR system, the paper notes that hallucination and repetition issues persist in some Arabic-Nougat models, which could affect extracted text quality.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by extracting Arabic tokens from over 8,500 books using the authors' Arabic-Nougat OCR system.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Source data consists of over 8,500 Arabic books.
rai:dataLimitations: The paper notes cross-script generalization and complex-layout challenges for the Arabic-Nougat pipeline used to extract the dataset, and mentions hallucination and repetition issues in some model variants.
rai:dataUseCases: The paper describes the dataset as a resource for downstream Arabic NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: The dataset was automatically extracted using the authors' Arabic-Nougat OCR model; the paper describes Arabic-Nougat as using a Donut vision encoder and an MBART decoder, with the Aranizer-PBE-86k tokenizer.
